THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
120
STUDY 153
Taupe Crop Cardigan & Brown Parachute Pants
Rights check
Source: 25049.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with a sleek black bob and
blunt bangs wears a taupe cropped long-sleeve
cardigan with a graphic print and small buttons over a
dark bralette. A black choker sits at her throat, and a
black leather shoulder bag hangs at one side. Wide
brown parachute cargo trousers with a drawstring and a
studded belt complete the look. Chunky black platform
slides finish the outfit. Her expression is calm and
direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of taupe,
chocolate, and black. Relaxed and utilitarian, in the
style of a streetwear catalog.
Relaxed, utilitarian, sporty
WORKING NOTES
- The cropped cardigan and parachute trousers are the
key pieces.
- Keep the blunt bob for a clean, graphic silhouette.
